name: Lyo.FantasyFootball.Api.Tests
tagline: API tests for fantasy football refresh, chat, and trades.
description: Postgres fixture plus a recording HTTP handler standing in for ESPN. Refresh persists groups, messages, and trades. Reads of a stored league do not call ESPN.
features: Posting a topic message and a direct message stores the user text.
Proposing a trade stores both sides.
Accepting a trade posts an accept with no items.
